title.en: Chapter 28 — A Story Along the Way

book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.ar: تاني يوم، القطار مر بأرض المورمون.
sentences.en: The next day, the train passed through Mormon country.

sentences.ar: وطلع بالعربة رجل طويل، بتياب سودا، وبيحكي بصوت عالي.
sentences.en: And a tall man came into the car, in black clothes, speaking in a loud voice.
He said: gentlemen!
A lecture on the Mormons!
Come!
And Passepartout went, because he loved to listen.
And the man talked, and talked.

sentences.ar: عن النبي سميث، وعن الرحلة للصحرا، وعن مدينة بحيرة الملح.
sentences.en: About the prophet Smith, the journey to the desert, Salt Lake City.

sentences.ar: وعن الرجل اللي إله سبع نسوان.
sentences.en: And about the man with seven wives.
And Passepartout said: seven wives!
And the donkey has one!

sentences.ar: وبمحطة بحيرة الملح، ركب رجل بيركض.
sentences.en: And at the Salt Lake station, a man boarded at a run.
And fell into the car, panting.
And Passepartout asked him: what are you running from?
The man said: from my wife.
Passepartout said: your wife?
One?
The man said: one.
And that is enough.
And Passepartout laughed until he cried.
And at night, Aouda sat with Passepartout.

sentences.ar: وقالت: حكي لي عن السيد فوغ.
sentences.en: And said: tell me about Mr. Fogg.
Passepartout said: what can I tell?
I know nothing about him.

sentences.ar: قالت: بس إنت معه من شهرين.
sentences.en: She said: but you have been with him two months.
He said: two months.

sentences.ar: وما شفته يضحك، ولا يزعل، ولا يستعجل.
sentences.en: And I have not seen him laugh, or get angry, or hurry.

sentences.ar: بس شفته يدفع ألفين جنيه عشاني.
sentences.en: But I have seen him pay two thousand pounds for me.
And carry a woman from the fire.
And Aouda said: I know.
And was silent.
And in the morning, the train was in the Rocky Mountains.
Rock, snow, bridges over the valleys.

sentences.ar: وباسبارتو بيتطلع من الشباك، وبيعد الأيام.
sentences.en: And Passepartout looking out of the window, counting the days.
5 December.
Sixteen days.
And said: we will make it.
We will make it.
And then, the train stopped.
In the middle of the mountains.
And there were no buffalo.
